name: Can I paint my exterior window trim?

mainEntity.name: Can I paint my exterior window trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, most types of exterior window trim can be painted, especially wood and cellular PVC. Painting allows you to customize the look of your home and protect the trim material from the elements. However, the type of paint and preparation required will vary based on the trim material. For example, wood trim needs proper sanding and priming, while PVC might require a specific type of paint designed for plastics. Vinyl trim is typically colored during manufacturing and is not usually painted. Regular repainting is part of the maintenance for painted trim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most exterior window trim, especially wood and cellular PVC, can be painted to customize its look and protect it. The painting process and paint type vary by material.
